summary: DOWNS is a maker of potato and vegetable handling equipment based in Sainte Marie Cappel, France. It builds graders, an optical grader, screen sizers, box fillers and tippers, store loaders, seed cutters and complete grading, storage and packhouse lines. It was founded in 1860 by Edward Walter DOWNS and has been part of the DUBRULLE Group since 2006.
ownership: Part of the DUBRULLE Group since 2006
machines: DOWNS CROPVISION: AI optical grader sorting unwashed potatoes by quality, up to 100 t/h; upgraded to CropVision Plus (shown at Interpom 2024, per the company)
DG potato grader: receives, cleans, grades and inspects potatoes; hoppers from 4 to 30 m3
DOWNS SUPERCHARGER: receiving hopper that feeds the grader continuously
SCOTTS Evolution: roller cleaning module for potatoes in wet or difficult conditions
DFL potato fieldloader: receives, cleans, grades, inspects and loads potatoes in the field
DS PREMIUM screen sizer: sizes potatoes on screens 600 to 2400 mm wide
Potato box filler DBF: automatic filler for any type of box, 50 boxes/hour
BOXMASTER: box tipper that empties potato boxes in front of a receiving hopper
Premium DT store loader: 14, 18 or 22 m loader for potato stores, 80 to 100 tons/hour
Potato seed cutter: cuts seed potatoes into two halves with hot knives, 7 tons/hour
markets: Present in 25 countries through the 5 continents
Potatoes, onions, carrots and other vegetables
France (DUBRULLE exclusive importer of DOWNS since 1981)
facts: Founded in 1860 by Edward Walter DOWNS, a blacksmith farrier
1981: DUBRULLE became the exclusive importer of DOWNS for the French market
Seed cutter knives heat up to 350° to kill pathogens
Builds whole machines in-house, from raw material to final assembly

The company states (Nov 2026) that CropVision, launched in 2021, inspects each potato over 360° with industrial cameras and AI, splits it into good product, second grade and waste, and is sold built into DOWNS hoppers and graders, as a standalone module (I-CropVision) or as a mobile unit
